Ivy L: Opening a follow-up thread for last night’s partial-response + silent-close pattern on /v1/streaming-chat.
Lin (SRE): Noted. Any short log sample?
Ivy L: Small trace: 
```
[02:03:11] conn=aa77 event=token_chunk bytes=640
[02:03:11] conn=aa77 event=HALF_CHUNK
[02:03:11] conn=aa77 tcp=FIN_SENT err=EOF
```
Marco - Networking: Likely idle-timeout or proxy restart. Will add passive capture on egress LB for 6h.
Sasha: Short-term: enable app-level heartbeat 10s and SO_KEEPALIVE on sockets. Low-risk.
Lin (SRE): Detection: add metric partial_chunks/total_chunks and alert at 0.2% over 5m. Also correlate with lb.conn_close_rate.
Ivy L: Owners: Marco - packet capture & LB checks, Sasha - runtime heartbeat + SDK resume, Lin - alerts + dashboard, Ivy - customer note.
Marco - Networking: Capture scheduled; will upload pcaps to incident folder.
Sasha: Will open runtime PR for heartbeat + SDK jittered backoff.
OpsBot: Ticket created: INFRA-1320; reviewers: @Marco - Networking, @Sasha.
Ivy L: Timeline: detection + alert in 12h, heartbeat patch in 36h, tcpdump analysis in 48h, customer update in 72h.
Lin (SRE): Adding a synthetic that simulates mid-stream RST to validate resume logic. Sasha, please add test to ci/synthetics.
Ivy L: Thanks all. I'll run a 10-min sync tomorrow 10:00 to confirm progress. :white_check_mark:
